default.value:
node = nuke.thisNode() 
node['licenseCheckTrigger'].execute() 
licenseCheckResult = node['licenseCheckResult'].getValue() != 0.0 
if licenseCheckResult: 
  w = node.screenWidth() 
  h = node.screenHeight() 
  x = node.xpos() + int(w/2) # bottom right corner 
  y = node.ypos() + int(h/2) 
  link = False 
  linkKnob = node['linkOutput'] 
  if linkKnob: 
    link = linkKnob.getValue() != 0.0 
  outputRotationKnob = 'panTiltRollS' # The default: stabilising C_SphericalTransform 
  metadataOnly = False # The default: actually do the transform 
  menuKnob = node['exportMenu'] 
  if menuKnob: 
    menuChoice = int(menuKnob.getValue()) 
    if menuChoice == 1 or menuChoice == 3: # match-moving C_SphericalTransform 
      outputRotationKnob = 'panTiltRollMM' 
    if menuChoice == 2 or menuChoice == 3: # metadata-only C_SphericalTransform 
      metadataOnly = True 
  transform = nuke.createNode('C_SphericalTransform2_1', '', False) 
  transform.setInput(0, node.input(0)) 
  transform.setXYpos(x + transform.screenWidth(), y + int(transform.screenHeight()/2)) 
  if link: 
    transform['panTiltRollOutput'].setExpression(node.name() + '.enabledAxes & 1 ? ' + node.name() + '.' + outputRotationKnob + '.x : 0', 0) 
    transform['panTiltRollOutput'].setExpression(node.name() + '.enabledAxes & 2 ? ' + node.name() + '.' + outputRotationKnob + '.y : 0', 1) 
    transform['panTiltRollOutput'].setExpression(node.name() + '.enabledAxes & 4 ? ' + node.name() + '.' + outputRotationKnob + '.z : 0', 2) 
  else: 
    if int(node['enabledAxes'].getValue()) & 1:      transform['panTiltRollOutput'].copyAnimation(0, node[outputRotationKnob].animation(0)) 
    if int(node['enabledAxes'].getValue()) & 2:      transform['panTiltRollOutput'].copyAnimation(1, node[outputRotationKnob].animation(1)) 
    if int(node['enabledAxes'].getValue()) & 4:      transform['panTiltRollOutput'].copyAnimation(2, node[outputRotationKnob].animation(2)) 
  if metadataOnly: 
    transform['metaDataOperation'].setValue('Transform')

description.text: Create a new spherical transform node based on the results of the solve: C_SphericalTransform (Stabilise): Create a C_SphericalTransform node with rotation configured to stabilise the tracked scene. C_SphericalTransform (Match-move): Create a C_SphericalTransform node with rotation configured to match the tracked scene. C_SphericalTransform (Stabilise, Metadata only): Create a SphericalTransform node, operating on metadata only, with rotation configured to stabilise the tracked scene. C_SphericalTransform (Match-move, Metadata only): Create a SphericalTransform node, operating on metadata only, with rotation configured to match the tracked scene.
Set a required feature separation to force feature tracks to cover the image. Reduce separation when increasing the number of features to track.
Set the threshold to detect features. A high value selects points that are distinct in a local region. A low value selects prominent points in areas of high contrast.
After the solve, refine the estimated camera motion via global optimisation. This will increase the solve time, but it may improve the solve accuracy.

This is the GPU that will be used for rendering, when Use GPU if available is selected. If you have more than one GPU in your machine, you can select a different GPU Device to use by editing your Preferences. (Note that selecting a different GPU will require a restart of Nuke to take effect.) Local GPU will be shown as Not available when any of the following is true: * Use CPU is selected as the GPU Device in your Preferences. * No suitable GPU was found on your system. Please refer to the documentation for details of the requirements for GPU acceleration. * It was not possible to create a context for processing on the selected GPU. For example, this can happen when there is not enough free memory available on the GPU. To use the GPU when rendering from the command line, add --gpu to your command.
Set the input mask to exclude regions from feature detection and tracking.

Set the rate at which analysis keys are created to define the camera motion. Increase this value to create more analysis keys in the solve to handle abrupt changes in motion. Lower this value to reduce the number of analysis keys and minimise drift in the calculated motion.
Link to the Tracker output so that cameras are updated with the solve.
Set the threshold to terminate a feature track. Increase the threshold to make tracking more tolerant to image changes and produce longer tracks.
Set the minimum length for tracks. Increase the track length to avoid short tracks in long sequences with slow camera movements and improve the solve.
Set the number of features to detect for tracking. Increasing the number of features will help in shots that are difficult to solve.

The size of the image patch that is tracked. Increase the patch size to create more stable tracks, reduce the patch size to ensure tracks are matched exactly.

node = nuke.thisNode() 
first = nuke.frame() 
last = max(node.firstFrame(), int(node['startFrame'].getValue())) 
frameRange = nuke.FrameRange(first, last, -1) 
p = nuke.Panel('Enter tracking range') 
p.addSingleLineInput('from:', str(frameRange.first())) 
p.addSingleLineInput('to:', str(frameRange.last())) 
p.addSingleLineInput('step:', str(frameRange.increment())) 
ret = p.show() 
if ret: 
  try: 
    first = int(p.value('from:')) 
    last = int(p.value('to:')) 
    increment = int(p.value('step:')) 
    frameRange = nuke.FrameRange(first, last, increment) 
  except ValueError: # value check 
    nuke.message('Invalid range values!') 
    cancelExecution = 1 
else: 
  cancelExecution = 1 
node = nuke.thisNode() 
node['licenseCheckTrigger'].execute() 
proceed = bool(node['licenseCheckResult'].getValue()) 
proceed = proceed and (not('cancelExecution' in locals()) or not cancelExecution) 
if proceed: 
  node['executeType'].setValue(1) 
  try: 
    nuke.execute(node, frameRange.first(), frameRange.last(), frameRange.increment()) 
  except RuntimeError as err: 
    if not err.args[0].startswith('Cancelled;'): # be quiet about cancellation, re-throw others 
      raise err 
  nuke.frame(int(node['lastExecutedFrame'].getValue())) 
cancelExecution = 0 # clean-up for the next execution

description.plain_text: C_Tracker 2.1v5: Analyse the motion of a camera rig from a Latlong video. Input: Connect a source video for automatically tracking through the entire input video. Optionally, a part of the footage can be excluded using a mask. Analysis: Analyse the sequence by tracking and solving. Auto-tracks can be reviewed in the viewer and outliers deleted as necessary for a more accurate solve. User tracks: Add tracks manually to lock stabilisation to particular regions or when solve from auto-tracks fails in challenging videos. Export: Export a stabilising or match-moving C_SphericalTransform, matching the result of the solve. Optionally edit only the metadata to avoid unnecessary filter hits. Transform: Use this C_Tracker node directly for stabilisation or match-moving.
